usedFor: Atlas AI Revenue Engine handles lead outreach, with “Add Contact to Campaign” and “Schedule Outbound Call” as its main steps.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Contact to Campaign” in Atlas AI Revenue Engine
bestTemplate.why: It puts a new lead into outreach, so calls and texts start without anyone entering the contact.

watchOut: “Send SMS” goes through your Atlas AI Revenue Engine account and reaches people outside, so it waits for your approval.
